name: omnisim
description: Build, inspect, run, and debug OmniSim robotics worlds from ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Build and debug live robot simulations
interface.longDescription: Use plain-language requests to load an OmniSim world, inspect geometry and robots, frame the camera, capture screenshots, step physics, read contacts and diagnostics, and verify edits through the first-party World Harness.
defaultPrompt: Build and verify a robot simulation from my description.
Inspect this OmniSim world and diagnose what is wrong.
Frame the robot, run the scene, and show me the result.
